text:
anya: Deploy-bot flagged embeddings.p95 degraded after merge to release/v2.6.0. Canary hold triggered.
deploy-bot: SAFETY_HOLD: embeddings.p95 > threshold (2x). Auto-rollback available.
sam: Do we let it auto-rollback? We risk touching dedicated pools for some customers.
zack: Prefer manual operator pin for hosted endpoints only, avoid dedicated churn.
anya: Agreed. ops-runner, pin hosted embeddings to v2.5.2, leave 1% canary on v2.6.0, and suppress auto-rollback. Reason: "post-merge p95 spike"
ops-runner: Running: `routerctl pin --route embeddings --target-tag v2.5.2 --canary 1 --reason "post-merge p95 spike"`
ops-runner: Pin done. Traffic: 99%->v2.5.2, 1% canary. Auto-rollback suppressed.
sre-jen: Noted correlation with kv_cache.evictions. Opening INF-1850 to investigate KV format/compat. Add regression test.
ops-runner: Quick smoke: login ok, embeddings-create latency back to baseline, quality sample looks fine (98/100).
sam: Ok that's promising. Let's define rollback criteria if it re-spikes: embeddings.p95 > 500ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> targeted rollback to v2.5.1.
kate: Drafting customer advisory: will mention temporary routing pin and ETA for next update (30m).
anya: Keep suppression for 1 hour, monitor closely. If patch INF-1850 lands we can attempt an A/B reroll at 10% with auto-rollback enabled (hosted only).
sre-jen: I'll own INF-1850 and coordinate ML oncall. Update thread with ticket link.
anya: Thanks all. Closing this loop for now; reopen if metrics change. :thumbsup:
